implementation_summary: Renumbered the Kafka-to-Pulsar decision from duplicate ADR-0377 to ADR-0520 while preserving renumbered_from provenance and keeping ADR-0377 assigned to the Forgejo board projection decision.
Verified ADR-0511 is Superseded and carries superseded_by: [ADR-0513]; AC-0.3 checks enforce that relationship without mutating statuses or branch protection.

Updated the logging/tracing standard to remove the stale VictoriaMetrics-as-canonical wording and point storage authority to ADR-0383/ADR-0186 while preserving ADR-0042 as instrumentation semantics only.
Added specs/adr-hygiene-registry.json, four GOOD/BAD fixtures, scripts/ci/assert-adr-hygiene.py, and scripts/tests/adr_hygiene_check.test.sh with fail-closed mutation probes.
Registered //:adr-hygiene-check in Buck2, the red/green fixture contract, automation matrix/coverage registry, Buck2 authority policy, and root-hub pointers.

Kept the modern Rust standards direction intact: Buck2-native local evidence remains the standard path, Cargo mutation testing remains local advisory in dual Cargo/Buck2 repositories, and no Tarpaulin/new oya CLI authority was introduced.
residual_risks: This is local/static ADR-hygiene seed evidence only; full ADR index regeneration remains explicitly unproven.
The live cloud-ci/oya-ci required context has not run on this candidate SHA; P0.0 remains blocked on trusted required-context evidence.
Future slices must expand from seed ADR-hygiene coverage to destination Rust gate packets before broad readiness claims are permitted.
